name: accordion-32
description: Careers page listing open roles that expand into a summary and an apply button.

files.content:
import { ArrowUpRight as ArrowUpRightIcon, ChevronDown as ChevronDownIcon, MapPin as MapPinIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/accordion" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" const roles = [ { value: "pd", title: "UI/UX Designer", team: "Design", location: "Remote", type: "Full-time", summary: "Design client websites and Designali blocks, from first sketch in Figma to polished UI.", }, { value: "fe", title: "Next.js Developer", team: "Engineering", location: "Remote", type: "Full-time", summary: "Turn Designali designs into fast, accessible Next.js and Tailwind CSS code.", }, { value: "cs", title: "Motion & 3D Designer", team: "Creative", location: "Remote", type: "Contract", summary: "Create CGI, 3D and motion work for Designali client projects and launches.", }, ] export default function AccordionJobOpenings() { return ( {roles.map((role) => ( {role.title} {role.location} · {role.team} {role.type}

{role.summary}

 ))} ) }
